admission.justification: A surviving ambient lifecycle makes a later module fail according to file scheduling rather than code.

applicability: Module boundaries in pytest processes loading the repository bootstrap plugin.
conditions: Only already-imported product modules are reset.
The ambient owner is stopped and its heartbeat joined before the module body and after its completion.
exclusions: No reset between ordered cases of one test file.
No eager import merely to reset an owner.
statement: Each test module resets already-imported product owners before and after execution and joins the ambient heartbeat.
